mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.2% signals a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and labor market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.2, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals increased economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only when accompanied by a rise in PAYEMS above 135000.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between INDPRO and PAYEMS
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when both conditions are met are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 1.5% YoY signals decreased economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between GDPC1 and economic downturns
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 205 signals increased inflation expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only when FEDFUNDS is above 5%.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between CPIAUCSL and inflation expectations
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when both conditions are met are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 136000 signals increased labor market activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other macro conditions.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between PAYEMS and labor market indicators
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when PAYEMS > 136000 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 350000 signals decreased consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during late-cycle expansions.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS < 350000 during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
